title: Exam-and-Eyewear Lens Credit on Cascade Vision Eyeglasses Orders
content:
**Member benefit note — Vision Plans**

An exam-and-eyewear lens credit is taken off the lens line's copays on an eyeglasses order. Its amount depends on the routine eye exam on record:

1. **15.00** when a routine eye exam of the enrollment on the order's date of service, under the same provider agreement as the order, carries the paid remark.
2. Otherwise, **8.00** when the latest routine eye exam of the enrollment whose remark is paid or out-of-network reimbursement paid is dated on or before the order and less than twelve whole calendar months (12) before it. A month is complete on the same day number.
   - When that latest exam is the only such exam on its date and has been reversed, there is taken to be none, and no earlier exam is looked at.
   - Where there are several such exams on that date, a reversal of one leaves that date standing.
3. Otherwise, no credit (0.00).

| Routine eye exam on record | Credit |
|---|---|
| Paid exam on the order date, same provider agreement | 15.00 |
| No such exam; latest paid or reimbursed exam on or before the order, under 12 whole months earlier | 8.00 |
| Latest exam 12 whole months or more before the order, or after it, or none | 0.00 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates).**
- Latest paid exam on 5 May; glasses ordered 4 May of the next year: 11 whole months, so the credit is 8.00.
- Ordered 5 May of the next year: 12 whole months, so no credit.
- An exam paid on the order date at a different practice is not under the same provider agreement. It earns 8.00 through the second line, not 15.00.
